title: Binance Futures Adds USDC Support and New Features to BFUSD
text: This is a general and marketing announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To further enhance users’ experience, Binance Futures is excited to share the following new updates for BFUSD. These updates will be available on both Binance website and Binance app from  2025-01-22 (UTC) . Key Updates USDC Support for BFUSD In addition to USDT, users can now buy BFUSD with USDC. Users can also choose to redeem USDT or USDC from their BFUSD holdings. Please note that fees may apply for purchase and redemption transactions. For more information, please refer to this  FAQ . From  2025-01-23 (UTC) , BFUSD daily rewards including Base and Boosted rewards will be  routinely issued in USDC . This applies to all BFUSD rewards, regardless of whether the BFUSD was purchased with USDT or USDC. Addition of Pre-Buy and Pre-Redeem Functions In the event when there is insufficient supply or BFUSD, USDT, or USDC, users can now Pre-Buy BFUSD and/or Pre-Redeem USDT or USDC.  Pre-Buy:  When there is not enough BFUSD for purchase, users can click on [Pre-Buy] on the BFUSD page and deposit USDT or USDC in advance to reserve BFUSD.  When BFUSD supply is replenished, users who have Pre-bought BFUSD will receive their BFUSD allocation.  Pre-Redeem : When there is not enough USDT or USDC available for redemption, users can click on [Pre-Redeem] and deposit BFUSD in advance to reserve USDT or USDC.  When USDT or USDC supply is replenished, users who have deposited BFUSD in advance will receive their USDT or USDC allocation. For more information, please refer to this  FAQ . Addition of New Data Metrics for Better Transparency Users can now view additional data metrics on the BFUSD page. The following charts and data metrics have been added: Protocol APY : A historical chart showing the Total APY from the Derivatives APY and Earn APY is added. Solvency : New charts for Total BFUSD Supply Trend and System Collateralized Trend are added. Transparency : A detailed summary on BFUSD’s Backing Notional including  Holdings and Positions are added. Refer to the  FAQ  for detailed information on the new data metrics added. How to Buy BFUSD on Binance Website Step 1: Login to your Binance Account and go to [Futures] - [ BFUSD ]. Step 2: Click on [Buy] and enter the amount to purchase. Step 3: Accept the terms and conditions, then click [Confirm] to complete the purchase. App Step 1: Go to [Futures], tap [...], and select [BFUSD]. Step 2: Tap [Buy] and enter the amount to purchase.
